🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of Meta Law Enforcement Portal Credentials  A darkweb forum post reveals that an underground actor is allegedly offering access to Meta’s Law Enforcement Online Request System (LEORS). According to the listing, the seller claims to possess verified law enforcement agency (LEA) account credentials for the portal, which is used by authorities to submit data disclosure requests to Meta platforms including WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram.  The post alleges that buyers can use these credentials to submit Basic Subscriber Information (BSI) requests. The types of data reportedly accessible through the system include: * Name at registration * Email address * Telephone number * Date and time of registration  Additionally, the listing claims the accounts have "Emergency Request" capabilities, allowing for priority processing of urgent cases with responses purportedly delivered within minutes. The seller states that no logs are kept on their side and accepts payment in Monero (XMR) or USDC.  The threat actor behind the post has a history of distributing large volumes of stolen credentials on underground forums. Previous activity includes the sale of hundreds of thousands of lines of "Fresh Private HQ ULP LOGS" and exclusive combolists for platforms like Twitter. This pattern suggests a focus on bulk credential theft and the monetization of access to sensitive systems.  Meta Inc., one of the world's largest technology companies, operates critical infrastructure for billions of users globally. If authentic, the compromise of LEORS credentials could enable unauthorized surveillance of private communications and the exfiltration of user data under false pretenses of legal authority. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach of the LEORS portal has not been independently verified by Meta or security researchers.

🇬🇧 NCA: “Com” Group Member Sentenced After 117 Teenage Victims Identified Worldwide  The UK’s National Crime Agency has sentenced Justin Swaddle, 20, from Leeds, following an investigation into his involvement in an online “Com” group — a community associated with coercion, blackmail, sexual abuse and self-harm. (National Crime Agency)  Investigators identified 117 female victims worldwide, aged 13–17, including eight in the UK. Swaddle operated online under aliases including “Epstein,” “Rugen” and “Moscow.” He was active across Discord, Telegram and Snapchat. The NCA says offenders in Com networks may be motivated by status and notoriety within the community, rather than primarily by money. Investigators found evidence of victims being coerced into self-harm and sexual activity, with threats involving intimate material and personal information. The investigation involved law enforcement partners in the US, Canada, Australia, Norway and New Zealand. Swaddle pleaded guilty to child sexual abuse offences and blackmail and was sentenced on August 10 to two years in prison, alongside a 10-year Sexual Harm Prevention Order.  Analyst Note: “Com” networks represent an especially disturbing form of decentralized online threat community. They can operate across mainstream messaging, social-media and gaming platforms, using doxxing, sextortion and psychological coercion to gain status through increasingly extreme abuse. For threat intelligence teams, tracking these ecosystems requires looking beyond conventional financially motivated cybercrime communities.  Source: UK National Crime Agency (NCA)  nationalcrimeagency.gov.uk/n…

🚨 Adobe Patches Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities Across ColdFusion, Commerce and Other Products  Adobe released its latest security updates on August 11, 2026, addressing vulnerabilities across ColdFusion, Adobe Commerce/Magento Open Source, Lightroom Classic, Content Credentials SDK and Adobe Campaign Classic. (Adobe Help Center)  The most urgent update is Adobe ColdFusion — APSB26-90, which carries Adobe’s highest Priority 1 rating. (Adobe Help Center)  CVE-2026-48362 — CVSS 10.0: unauthenticated OS command injection leading to arbitrary code execution. CVE-2026-48273 — CVSS 9.9: eval injection potentially allowing arbitrary code execution. Multiple additional critical vulnerabilities can enable code execution, privilege escalation, security-feature bypass, denial of service and memory exposure. ColdFusion 2025 2025.0.11 and earlier and ColdFusion 2023 2023.0.22 and earlier are affected. Adobe recommends upgrading to ColdFusion 2025 Update 12 or ColdFusion 2023 Update 23. (Adobe Help Center)  Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source also received patches for several critical vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1), an incorrect-authorization flaw that can allow privilege escalation without authentication or administrative privileges. (Adobe Help Center)  Importantly, Adobe says it is not aware of exploitation in the wild for the ColdFusion or Commerce vulnerabilities addressed by these updates. (Adobe Help Center)  Analyst Note: ColdFusion deserves immediate attention because CVE-2026-48362 is network exploitable, requires no authentication or user interaction, and carries the maximum CVSS score of 10.0. Given ColdFusion’s history as a target for threat actors, internet-facing deployments should be identified and patched as a priority. 🤖 [GEMINI 분석] 2026-08-13 07:45 KST
🟠 위협 점수: 8/10 (높음)

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 위협 환경은 AI를 활용한 공격의 고도화와 기존 취약점의 신속한 악용이 결합된 양상을 보입니다. 특히 대만 정부를 대상으로 한 'near-autonomous' AI 공격 사례가 보고되며, AI 에이전트가 스스로 판단하고 공격 경로를 수정하는 새로운 위협 모델이 현실화되었습니다([CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/near-autonomous-ai-attack-government-target-taiwan/)). 또한, Microsoft Patch Tuesday를 통해 공개된 취약점들이 PoC 공개 직후 즉각적으로 악용되는 등 공격자의 대응 속도가 매우 빨라졌으며([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/sharepoint-vulnerability-exploited-shortly-after-poc-release/)), Chrome 확장 프로그램을 위장한 대규모 트래픽 리다이렉션 공격이 지속적으로 발견되고 있습니다([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hundreds-of-fake-chrome-vpn-extensions-route-traffic-through-a-proxy/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
*   **Lazarus Group**: Windows Zero-Day 취약점을 악용하여 SYSTEM 권한을 획득하고 신규 백도어를 배포함([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/lazarus-exploits-windows-zero-day-to-gain-system-access-and-deploy-backdoor.html)).
*   **Sandworm**: 채용 담당자로 위장하여 우크라이나 IT 전문가를 대상으로 화상 면접을 유도하고 악성코드를 배포하는 스피어피싱 캠페인 수행([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208027)).
*   **Head Mare**: 패치되지 않은 TrueConf 서버 취약점을 악용하여 PhantomCore 및 PhantomGraph 백도어 배포([Securelist](https://securelist.com/tr/head-mare-targets-trueconf-server-with-phantomcore/120988/)).
*   **Kimwolf (Botnet)**: Android IoT 기기를 타겟으로 하며, Ethereum 블록체인을 C2 통신에 활용하고 Chrome 트래픽으로 위장하는 등 탐지 회피 기술 고도화([Unit42](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/kimwolf-v7-botnet-malware/)).

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
*   **이스트시큐리티 알약(ESRC)**: 국내 정부기관 담당자를 대상으로 상품 파손 클레임을 사칭한 스피어피싱 메일 유포 확인([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5773)).
*   **다크웹 동향**: AhnLab ASEC 보고서에 따르면 7월 다크웹 내 한국 관련 게시물 중 일부는 AI로 생성된 허위 데이터이거나 실제 침해 여부가 불분명한 사례가 포함되어 있어 교차 검증이 필요함([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94911/)).

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
*   **CVE-2026-58231**: SAP Commerce Cloud, CVSS 10.0, 인증되지 않은 공격자의 원격 코드 실행 가능([TheHackersNews](https://twitter.com/TheHackersNews/status/2087442602614550647)).
*   **CVE-2026-20349**: Cisco ASA/FTD, CVSS 8.6, 원격 재부팅 및 DoS 공격 악용 확인([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208028)).
*   **CVE-2026-65640**: WordPress Core, CVSS 8.8, RCE 취약점([Twitter-moh_e_a](https://twitter.com/moh_e_a/status/2087667456282169756)).

### 5. IOC 요약
*   **CVE**: 
    *   CVE-2026-71362 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-exploit-critical-adobe-commerce-flaw-to-hijack-customer-accounts/))
    *   CVE-2026-20349 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208028))

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
*   **Cisco 장비 점검**: CVE-2026-20349 취약점 패치 적용 및 외부 노출된 관리 인터페이스 접근 제어 강화.
*   **Chrome 확장 프로그램 감사**: 조직 내 사용 중인 VPN/Proxy 관련 Chrome 확장 프로그램 전수 조사 및 불필요한 확장 프로그램 삭제.
*   **스피어피싱 대응**: 채용 관련 화상 면접이나 상품 파손 클레임 등 사회공학적 기법을 활용한 메일 수신 시 첨부파일 실행 금지 및 보안팀 보고 체계 가동.

### 7. 위협 수준 평가
*   **점수**: 8/10
*   **근거**: AI 기반의 자율적 공격 도구 등장과 더불어, 패치 직후 악용되는 Zero-Day 및 Critical 취약점이 다수 발견되어 기업 인프라의 즉각적인 보안 패치와 모니터링이 필수적인 시점임.
